## Built around your project.

### Respects your design system.

Build and refine with your existing colors, components, and rules. New pages feel like part of the same product.

/impeccable polish : scanning codebase

› Walking src/…

✓src/styles/tokens.css 14 colors, 6 font sizes, 7 spacing steps

✓tailwind.config.ts theme.extend merged

✓src/components/34 components

· Button: primary, secondary, ghost, destructive

· Card: 3 variants, 8px / 16px radii

· Input, Select, Dialog, Toast, Table…

✓DESIGN.md brand rules loaded

→ Using your existing design rules.

### Tell it what matters to your users.

Explain your users and their goals once. Impeccable saves that context in `PRODUCT.md` and reads it before design work.

PRODUCT.md Markdown

1.   ## Users
2.   People responding to service outages, often on a phone.

4.   ## Product Purpose
5.   Help teams find what caused an outage.

7.   ## Accessibility & Inclusion
8.   Keep alerts readable on small screens.

Read by

polish audit layout

### Keep your design decisions.

`/impeccable document` records your visual system in `DESIGN.md`, ready for the next feature or the next agent.

### Design for the job at hand.

Help people decide on a landing page, or get things done in a dashboard. Impeccable designs for the task.

*   Persuade
*   Operate
*   Read
*   Experience

### Catch slop as your agent works.

The design hook checks UI edits and sends findings back to your agent. It runs in code, without an AI model or API key.

1.   Agent edits the page`Hero.tsx`
2.   Detector reports issues AI beige Clipped label
3.   Agent fixes them`Hero.tsx`Second pass
4.   No issues detected 0 findings

[Set up hooks for your web project →](https://impeccable.style/docs/hooks#allow-the-hook-in-your-harness)

## Install Impeccable

Install the skill, switch on automatic design checks, and make something you’re proud of.

1 Install Impeccable

Install via

CLI Codex Claude plugin skills.sh

Run in your project folder, then follow the prompts.

$`npx impeccable install`Copy

In ChatGPT or Codex, open the **Plugins** tab and search for **Impeccable**.

Open its details and select the **+** button to install. Then start a new chat in your project and continue to step 2.

In the Claude Code chat, add the marketplace:

›`/plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable`Copy

Then open `/plugin`, choose **Discover**, and install **Impeccable**.

Run in your terminal:

$`npx skills add pbakaus/impeccable`Copy

Installs the shared skill. Use the CLI for integrations tailored to your coding tool.

Tool support & updates

The CLI adapts Impeccable to your coding tool. Choose an install for this project or all your projects.

**GitHub Copilot app:** Impeccable is built in. Enable it in **Settings → Experimental**.

Update later with `npx impeccable update`Copy

Manage Impeccable from the **Plugins** tab in ChatGPT or Codex.

Update through the `/plugin` menu in Claude Code.

Update Impeccable with `npx skills update impeccable`Copy

Next: set up your project →

2 Initialize & enable hooks

Give your agent context about your product and design direction, then enable hooks to catch design issues as it works.

### Your coding tool must also allow hooks

After running the commands below, complete your tool’s hook approval or workspace trust steps so checks can run.

**Using Codex?** Open **Settings → Hooks** in the app, or `/hooks` in the CLI. Review and trust Impeccable’s `PostToolUse` and `Stop` hooks. They won’t run until you do.

[Check the approval steps for your tool →](https://impeccable.style/docs/hooks#allow-the-hook-in-your-harness)

Using Other tools Codex

### Initialize your project

Reload your coding tool. In the agent chat, run:

›`/impeccable init`Copy

### Turn on automatic checks

›`/impeccable hooks on`Copy

Already enabled? Your agent will confirm the current setup.
